original_ai_output.title_zh: 耶伊启动选民教育，呼吁防止选举暴力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹中赤道州耶伊河县当局与发展伙伴启动公民与选民教育项目，旨在促进民众和平参与民主进程，并在12月22日大选前防止选举相关暴力。该项目名为“提升公民声音”，由Reconcile International在耶伊镇、莫罗博和卡亚实施。地方官员呼吁社区领袖举报安全威胁和政治恐吓，并澄清正式竞选活动尚未开始。

location.raw_text: Yei River County of Central Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 耶伊河县启动公民与选民教育项目以促进和平选举参与
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities and development partners in Yei River County of Central Equatoria State have launched a civic and voter education project to promote peaceful participation in democratic processes
ahead of the general elections slated for 22 December

key_facts.fact: 项目由Reconcile International在耶伊镇、莫罗博和卡亚实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: will be implemented in Yei Town Payam, Morobo and Kaya

key_facts.fact: 地方官员呼吁举报安全威胁和政治恐吓
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged local leaders to report security threats and political intimidation in their communities to relevant authorities

key_facts.fact: 正式政治竞选活动尚未开始，有待全国选举委员会正式宣布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: formal political campaigns have not yet started, pending an official announcement by the National Elections Commission

uncertainties: 报道为单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
选举能否如期于12月22日举行尚未获确认
